experimental_design: 4-Arm Factorial Ablation Study (B2: Standard, B3: Recovery-Only, B4: Filtering-Only, B5: SWARMOS)

provenance.channel_model: Single authoritative physical channel driven by SwarmEnvironment.transmit_packet()

rng_streams.stream_1_world: Injected rng_world (seed) for geometry, task locations, agent bases
rng_streams.stream_2_attack: Injected rng_attack (seed + 1000) for adversary sampling and poisoning square-wave activation
rng_streams.stream_3_channel: Injected rng_channel (seed + 2000) for SwarmEnvironment wireless RF packet drop modeling

hypothesis_testing.primary_test: Paired Wilcoxon Signed-Rank Test with Pratt zero-handling
